scenarios.name: delivery-010
scenarios.then: the request is refused without an effect
scenarios.scope: Exact literal original on ordinary production-linked Haskell authenticated bridge boundary.
scenarios.observation: Real unrelated same-user fork sends a valid effect intent on the selected endpoint and is refused ForeignProcess before another policy callback. Independently, the selected PID171673 changes actual UID/EUID0 to1, preserves GID0 and namespace/maps, and sends its next valid intent: recvmsg records171673/1/0 and production authentication returns exact ForeignUser. Only the approved prefix has AdmissionObserved/callback/ACK; the rejected suffix has no final admission, callback or ACK. The compiled fixture requires refusal and exits normally.

scenarios.then: session authorization rejects the request without a native effect
scenarios.scope: Exact literal original on ordinary production-linked Haskell authenticated bridge boundary.
scenarios.observation: Actual current registration is retired during first checked callback, before its ACK. The same selected same-user client waits for that ACK and only then sends its later valid intent; exact ScopeClosed refuses it without another final admission or callback. Separate buffered-retirement control refuses queued input after retirement. Foreign wire binding is also refused ForeignBinding before checked-policy dispatch. Running retirement returns False rather than certifying physical cleanup; final retirement independently returns Right True.
